concerns.text: Phase 6 (Tasks T032-T037) introduces game-theoretic concepts (Nash equilibrium, utility functions, strategic response) that have NO matching requirement in spec.md or plan.md. The spec explicitly assumes 'associational' framing (FR-006) and lacks data for utility functions. These tasks are unanchored to any FR/SC/Plan element, creating scope creep that cannot be validated against the current spec.

Task T030 (E-value calculation) is present in tasks.md but lacks a corresponding tag or explicit description linking it to a specific FR/SC. While the plan mentions E-values in 'Complexity Tracking', there is no FR-XXX or SC-XXX in the spec mandating this specific metric, leaving the task unanchored to a formal requirement.

Duplicate Task IDs: T024 and T025 are used twice. T024 appears in Phase 4 (PSW weight stability test) and Phase 5 (Permutation test). T025 appears in Phase 4 (GLS fallback test) and Phase 5 (Sensitivity analysis test). This ID collision breaks traceability and makes it impossible to uniquely map tasks to requirements.

Task T042 (Run quickstart.md validation) is present, but there is no explicit task in the plan or spec to 'measure and report' the pipeline runtime against the 6-hour limit (SC-005). While T040 mentions performance optimization, no task explicitly verifies the SC-005 success criterion (runtime measurement) in the final artifact.
